cards.name: Phlogiston's Wake

effects.printed_clause: On activation optionally pay any LP in 300 multiples, then choose one listed effect; only one effect of this name per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation cost offers payable 300 multiples; target requires a controlled Phlogiston Dragon and records one branch. Activation and GY effect share SetCountLimit(1,id), enforcing one named effect total.

official_references.matched_structure: LP-cost event/payment structure and turn-scoped accounting.

effects.printed_clause: Give a controlled "Phlogiston Dragon" 1 additional attack this Battle Phase for each lower-ATK opponent monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The chosen Phlogiston Dragon now receives EFFECT_EXTRA_ATTACK with a value equal to the number of lower-ATK opponent monsters through the End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Official unqualified additional attacks use EFFECT_EXTRA_ATTACK rather than EFFECT_EXTRA_ATTACK_MONSTER.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: EFFECT_EXTRA_ATTACK_MONSTER restricted the granted attacks to monsters even though the printed text grants unqualified additional attacks.

effects.printed_clause: For the rest of the turn, opponent monsters must attack one chosen "Phlogiston Dragon", if able.
effects.lua_implementation: Registers both EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK and EFFECT_MUST_ATTACK_MONSTER through end turn, with the chosen Dragon as value.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this card from GY, target a FIRE monster in GY, Special Summon in Defense; shares the one-effect-per-turn restriction.
effects.lua_implementation: GY ignition banishes self as cost, targets a Necrovalley-legal FIRE monster, and revives it in Defense; shared id count.

official_references.matched_structure: GY cost plus targeted GY Special Summon operation.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and fixed the additional-attack type: the unqualified printed attacks now use EFFECT_EXTRA_ATTACK rather than monster-only attacks.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
